title: aiPHeed generalization study: pre-registered protocol and acceptance rule
written_before_running: No model in this study had been run when this file was written. Earlier runs on the same 55 outer rows (MODEL-A, MODEL-B, MODEL-B2, E0-E7, robustness and overfitting audits) are disclosed as prior exposure.

fixed_elements.outer_folds: expanding window, minimum 8 target quarters, 11 outer test quarters 2022-Q4..2025-Q4, 55 rows; five provinces of a quarter always together
fixed_elements.inner_validation: walk-forward inside the outer training set, minimum 5 inner target quarters; score = mean inner quarter accuracy

primary_estimand: Outer mean quarter accuracy of the NESTED PROCEDURE P, which inside every outer fold picks one configuration from the fixed pool below using inner validation only; ties go to the earliest entry in the pool order (simplest first).

families: logistic_l2 (standardised in-fold; C in {0.01,0.1,1,10}; class_weight in {none, balanced})
decision_tree (max_depth in {1,2,3}; min_samples_leaf 5; class_weight in {none, balanced})
lightgbm (defaults, and num_leaves 4 / min_child_samples 10 / n_estimators 100 / learning_rate 0.05; weighting in {none, scale_pos_weight})
pool_order_simplest_first.order: feature set (12, 42, 47) x family (logistic, tree, lightgbm) x complexity ascending x weighting (none first)

descriptive_comparisons_not_used_for_sel: each pool member at fixed configuration
ablations: no commodity, no price levels, no price-related, quarter-common features only, province-varying features only

acceptance_rule.C2_statistical: one-sided 95% lower bound >= 0.75 for P's accuracy, BOTH (a) quarter-cluster bootstrap 5th percentile (10,000 draws of the 11 quarters) and (b) exact Clopper-Pearson one-sided 95% on rows
acceptance_rule.C3_beats_baselines: P better than timing-valid persistence AND clock-only: mean quarter difference > 0 with quarter-bootstrap 5th percentile > 0
acceptance_rule.C4_stability: leave-one-calendar-year-out mean accuracy >= 0.75 for every year removed
acceptance_rule.C5_prospective: accuracy on labelled quarters after 2025-Q4, scored with the configuration frozen before those labels existed; NOT evaluable now (no labels)

verdicts.OBSERVED_ONLY: C1 passes but C2, C3 or C4 fails

feasibility_computed_before_running.note: Rows are not independent (5 provinces share a quarter), so these powers are optimistic.
